```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(reactable)
```

```{r}

df1 <- read.csv("http://manctsui.github.io/datasets/timesData.csv")
reactable(df1, defaultPageSize = 4, searchable = TRUE)
```

```{r}

UCLArank <- df1 |>
  select(year, university_name, world_rank) |>
  filter(
    year %in% 2012:2016,
    university_name == "University of California, Los Angeles"
  )

reactable(UCLArank)

```

```{r}
UCBerkeleyrank <- df1 |>
  select(year, university_name, world_rank) |>
  filter(
    year %in% 2012:2016,
    university_name == "University of California, Berkeley"
  )
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(UCLArank$year, UCLArank$world_rank, xlab = "Year", ylab = "World Rank", main ="UCLA World University Rank", type ="l")
plot(UCBerkeleyrank$year, UCBerkeleyrank$world_rank, xlab = "Year", ylab = "World Rank", main ="UC Berkeley World University Rank", type ="l")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

$$\text{United States University Ranking (Top 50) through 2012-2016 } $$

```{r}
#| echo: false
USUniversity <- df1 |>
  select(year,university_name,country,world_rank) |>
  filter(year %in% 2012:2016, country == "United States of America", world_rank <= 50)|>
  count(year)
reactable(USUniversity)

```

Throughout the years 2012–2016, the number of U.S. universities ranked in the top 50 did not change much.

From 2012 through 2015, the number was around 90, while 2016 had the highest number, with 112 universities.
